ITA-9.6.191 vibandhaḥ विबन्धः
Multi-tailed bandage
A type of bandage used in regions such as the back, abdomen, and chest.

ITA-5.76.82 vibandhavyāpat विबन्धव्यापत्
Condition of constipation due to faulty purgative therapy
A condition characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: obstruction of flatus; obstruction to passage of urine/retention; obstruction/retention of faeces; gurgling intestinal sounds/borborygmi; burning sensation; fever; severe pain.
